insurer: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: ₹ XXXX (Individual Sum Insured or Floater Sum Insured as per policy)

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: Reset Benefit – The Sum Insured will be reset up to 100% once a policy year for same illness and Unlimited times for different illness
great.explanation: Sum insured is restored by 100% once in a policy year for the same illness, and unlimited times for different illnesses. This reduces the chance of exhausting cover in a year with multiple hospitalizations.

great.name: NCB
great.quote: Loyalty Bonus- A Get a 20% loyalty bonusof the Annual Sum Insured, up to a max of 100%... No reduction to the cumulative bonus even in case of a claim.
great.explanation: A 20% loyalty bonus is added on the annual sum insured each year up to 100%, and it is not reduced even if you make a claim. This helps your available cover keep growing instead of resetting to zero after claims.

good.name: Room Rent
good.reference: Policy Coverage i.Basic Covers: 1; also repeated under Financial limits of coverage
good.explanation: Room rent is covered up to a “Single Private Room”. This is market-standard, but choosing a higher category room may lead to extra costs depending on hospital billing.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Pre Hospitalization Medical expenses  - 60 days before hospitalization
good.explanation: Medical expenses are covered for 60 days before hospitalization. This helps pay for tests, consultations, and medicines leading up to admission.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Post Hospitalization Expenses –180 days after discharge
good.explanation: Medical expenses are covered for 180 days after discharge. This supports follow-up treatment and medicines during recovery.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre -existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.reference: Exclusions i. Standard Exclusion 1. Code- Excl01- Pre-Existing Diseases
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are not covered for the first 24 months of continuous coverage. After 24 months, PED-related claims become payable as per policy terms.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses for listed conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage post first policy inception.
good.reference: Exclusions i. Standard Exclusion 2. Code- Excl02
good.explanation: Listed specific illnesses/procedures are not covered for 24 months from first policy inception. Claims for these conditions will be payable only after this waiting period ends.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Initial waiting period: 30 days for all illnesses (except hospitalization due to injury)
good.reference: Waiting period section; also Excl03-30-day waiting period
good.explanation: Illness-related hospitalization is not covered in the first 30 days, while hospitalization due to injury is covered. This is a standard waiting period in retail health insurance.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote: Domestic Air Ambulance Cover  - Covers expenses during emergencies up to the annual Sum Insured.
good.explanation: Domestic air ambulance expenses in emergencies are covered up to the annual sum insured. This can significantly reduce costs for critical transfers when medically necessary.

bad.name: Disease Sub-limits
bad.quote: * 2 years after policy inception, the maximum liability arising out of any Claim from a cataract treatment claim shall be restricted to up to 10% of the Annual Sum Insured subject to a maximum of ₹1 Lakh per eye.
bad.reference: List of specific diseases/procedure (Cataract note); also repeated under Financial limits of coverage
bad.explanation: Cataract claims are capped at 10% of annual sum insured, subject to a maximum of ₹1 lakh per eye (after 2 years from inception). If your cataract bill exceeds this cap, you will have to pay the difference.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Non-medical and non-payable expenses are your responsibility.
bad.explanation: Non-medical and non-payable items are not covered and must be paid by you. This can increase out-of-pocket costs for common hospital consumables and disposables.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote:
Voluntary co-payment opted- XX% will be applicable for each and every claim

Zone Based Pricing – Premium depends on your chosen zone. If treatment is conducted in a higher zone, co-payment applies.
bad.reference: Financial limits of coverage (Co-payment; Zone Based Pricing); also Optional Covers: Voluntary Co-payment
bad.explanation: A co-payment of XX% applies on each and every claim if voluntary co-pay is opted, and co-payment also applies if you take treatment in a higher zone than your chosen zone. This means part of every such claim is paid by you, reducing the insurer’s payout.

unclear.name: Cashless Network
unclear.quote: Find our extensive list of hospitals providing cashless services on our website https://www.icicilombard.com/health-insurance/health-claim/partner-hospital or on the IL TakeCare App.
unclear.explanation: Cashless hospitals are available via the insurer’s website/app, but the policy does not state the number of network hospitals. You should check the current list for your city and preferred hospitals before buying.

unclear.name: Built-in SI Buffer
unclear.quote: Sum Insured Protector – Protects the sum insured against the rising inflation by linking the Sum insured under the base plan to the consumer price index (CPI).
unclear.explanation: Sum insured can be linked to CPI under the “Sum Insured Protector” optional cover, but the exact increase mechanism/limits are not stated in this excerpt. Since it is optional and not clearly quantified here, confirm the schedule/endorsement terms before relying on it.

unclear.name: Consumables
unclear.quote: Claim Protector - If claim has been accepted under “Inpatient treatment” or “Daycare procedure”, then items which are included in the list of excluded items not payable in that particular claim will become payable up to the Annual Sum Insured under the policy.
unclear.explanation: An optional “Claim Protector” add-on makes otherwise excluded non-payable items payable up to the annual sum insured for inpatient/daycare claims. Since it is optional and depends on the excluded-items list for that claim, confirm the add-on scope and list before purchase.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
